remaining_numeric_sections: Section 10 of that source, fix \eqref{dao:eq-13}--\eqref{dao:eq-17}, including all midpoint and reflection factors. The \href{https://sashakolpakov.github.io/murakamis_dream/notes/actual_main_meridian_direct_crossing_trace.html}{direct-crossing trace}, Sections 2--4 of that source, fixes the finite translated grids and their endpoint currents. The \href{https://sashakolpakov.github.io/murakamis_dream/notes/actual_main_meridian_source_bounds.html}{full source bounds}, (D9)--(D14), supply the full polynomial norm used in regeneration, including constant normal channels; the extension to compact nonreal parameters is checked in Section~\ref{dao:sec-3} above. The \href{https://sashakolpakov.github.io/murakamis_dream/notes/actual_main_meridian_exact_scalar.html}{exact scalar calculation} fixes \eqref{dao:eq-20} and the one reduced cut.

Sections 5--10 of that source, supplies the marked reconstructed branch and the preferred longitude, with its Section 5 complete filled-point anchor checked in Section~\ref{dao:sec-7} above for the new certificate. The positive geometric path depends on \eqref{dao:eq-23}, not on the older summed or maximum-based source criterion. Thus no old analytic class restriction is silently used to identify the new source branch.
